paragraphs: Codoxo sells a Unified Cost Containment Platform that uses generative AI and automation to shift left in the payment cycle. The company names healthcare payers, government agencies, and pharmacy benefit managers as the organizations it works with.

The idea it puts first is pre-claim provider education, delivering insights before claims are created so the first submission is accurate. Another module identifies claim accuracy issues before claims are paid, pairing claim insights with a claim workflow and automated provider outreach. Fraud, waste and abuse tools detect new and emerging schemes, streamline evidence chain collections, and integrate investigation workflows. Generative AI is also applied to medical record reviews to speed them up and increase audit accuracy. A separate check validates provider contracts and medical policies to reduce manual payment errors.

Alongside the software, Codoxo sells services, among them a virtual SIU that takes on compliance work and scales operations. The company says it is reducing healthcare costs for over 167 million lives. It claims $60+ PMPY in cost savings with less provider friction. The site identifies Musheer Ahmed as chief executive and co-founder.

quote.text: Achieve $60+ PMPY in cost savings with less provider friction
